# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-24

This X4 Pro release unifies navigation chrome and compact settings menus across the firmware.

## Added

- A shared X4 Pro top bar with the clock, centered window title, and battery indicator.
- Reader bars now show the book title at the top and chapter title at the bottom, truncated when necessary.
- A reusable compact settings-list style with icons and graphical toggles.

## Improved

- Settings, text options, status-bar options, KOReader, keyboard layouts, language, OPDS, button mapping, and the EPUB reader menu now share consistent row geometry.
- Textual on/off values in supported parameter menus are replaced by native toggle controls.
- The home screen keeps the shared clock and battery bar without a center title.

## Notes

- This release is built exclusively for the Xteink X4 Pro.
